request: The accent chairs look odd and are lined up against a wall. Replace them with visually simple, compatible seating and arrange a useful cozy conversation area. You may replace the living-room furniture; keep the other rooms unchanged.

arguments.style_request: Remake the living room in minimalistic style but cozy. The accent chairs look odd and are lined up against a wall. Replace them with visually simple, compatible seating and arrange a useful cozy conversation area. You may replace the living-room furniture; keep the other rooms unchanged. Avoid token styling changes or chairs lined up without a useful seating relationship.

reply.message:
The catalog currently returned no compatible, dimensioned replacement seating or complete room set, so I couldn’t produce a checked preview.

The intended arrangement is simple upholstered seating facing inward around a shared table and rug—not chairs lined along a wall. Nothing has changed, including the other rooms. Budget remains unconfirmed, and no replacement cost is available.
